topic: iOS 27: Apple dropped zero devices, but the features are gated behind RAM — the three-tier split
details: iOS 27 ships fall 2026 alongside the iPhone launch. Same device list as iOS 26 (iPhone 11+, SE 2nd gen+). But three tiers: full Siri AI needs 12GB RAM (17 Pro, 17 Pro Max, iPhone Air only); standard Apple Intelligence 8GB+; everyone else gets iOS 27 with no AI. Universal: continuous Liquid Glass transparency slider, rebuilt CPU scheduler, rebuilt system search. Siri AI blocked in the EU (DMA) and China at launch.
